key_idea: The hole must be inside every one of the 4 pieces of paper.
steps: Point A is only on the pink paper.
Point B is on the pink and yellow papers, but it is left of the green paper and above the blue paper.
Point C is on the pink, yellow and green papers, but it is above the blue paper.
Point D is inside the pink, yellow, blue and green papers. All 4!

choice_feedback.A: Point A is only on the pink paper.
choice_feedback.B: Point B misses the green paper and the blue paper.
choice_feedback.C: Point C is above the blue paper, so the hole misses it.
choice_feedback.E: Point E is below the pink paper, so the hole misses it.
